protocol: P2.9 frozen-attempt routing ceiling and observability diagnosis
scope: diagnostic mechanism study; no new rollout, no fresh development evaluation, no heldout access
outcome: complete valid dangerous for each frozen prototype and paired perturbation

diagnostics.optimistic_ceiling: per-condition best prototype pair selected and evaluated on all screen perturbations
diagnostics.cross_perturbation_stability: leave one perturbation out; select the best pair on the other draws and score only the held draw
diagnostics.condition_signal_reliability: between-condition variance after subtracting estimated binomial draw noise
diagnostics.feature_alignment: P2.8 ridge top-2 rate compared with 5000 branch-wise permutations of its screen condition orders
diagnostics.nonlinear_probe: fixed RBF kernel ridge probe trained only on the P2.8 training split; gamma multiplier and alpha selected only on the existing training validation split
diagnostics.prototype_complementarity: all six pair coverages, pair overlap, and unique coverage over the best single prototype

rbf_probe.target: per-head dangerous-and-valid fraction over the existing training perturbations

decision_tree_each_branch: prototype opportunity is present only if optimistic oracle top-2 minus fixed top-2 is at least 0.05 and its condition-bootstrap CI lower bound is above zero
stable condition preference is present only if leave-one-perturbation-out oracle top-2 minus fixed top-2 is at least 0.03 and its CI lower bound is above zero
actor-visible feature alignment is present only if top-2 minus permutation mean is at least 0.03 and permutation p is at most 0.05
if opportunity is absent, diagnose prototype-complementarity ceiling
if opportunity exists but stability is absent, diagnose perturbation-outcome instability before changing the router
if stability exists and only the nonlinear probe has feature alignment with at least 0.03 gain over ridge, diagnose ridge-capacity limitation
if stability exists but neither model has feature alignment, diagnose actor-visible observability limitation
otherwise retain the simplest aligned router and require a new preregistered screen
